name: Colossus wartime codebreaking
summary: Colossus was an electronic valve machine at Bletchley Park that read punched tape at high speed to help British codebreakers break German Lorenz teleprinter ciphers.
description: Vacuum-tube Colossus machine at Bletchley Park processing punched tape to assist breaking Lorenz traffic.

why: Wartime British codebreakers needed to test Lorenz cipher settings far faster than people or electromechanical machines could.
